Want to get the best camera features has long been said to require buying Apple’s largest iPhone Pro. So far, most reports have indicated that there will be no camera differences between the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max, but a leaker has now cast some doubt on that claim.

Specifically, they say that two new features originally expected to be available on both Pro models may instead be exclusive to the Pro Max …

The iPhone 17 Pro and Pro Max offer exactly the same camera specs, with all three rear lenses featuring 48-megapixel sensors. Apple says the telephoto lens provides up to 8x optical zoom, but this is actually achieved through cropping a 24-megapixel image, so it is more accurate to say it offers 4x optical zoom, with a cropped 8x option.

So far, the general expectation has been that this year’s two Pro models will remain on par in terms of camera features, both featuring a main lens with a variable aperture, and a telephoto lens with a larger aperture for better low-light performance.

However, leaker Ice Universe says that two new telephoto lens features may be exclusive to the iPhone 18 Pro Max.

If true, this means that to get the longest telephoto reach and the best low-light performance you’ll need to buy the Pro Max. However, the leaker used the word “may,” reflecting a lack of full confidence in the claim, perhaps having seen conflicting evidence in Apple’s supply chain.

There have also been reports that the main lens’s variable aperture system may be exclusive to the Pro Max, but coverage on this is mixed.

If you’ve always preferred the smaller of the two Pro models, would you switch to the Pro Max for better camera capabilities? Let us know in the comments.
